hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; [ -z "$f" ] && exit 0; d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; cd "$d" || exit 0; case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx|*.mjs|*.json|*.css|*.md) direnv exec "$d" ./node_modules/.bin/prettier --write "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 ;; esac; case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx|*.mjs) direnv exec "$d" ./node_modules/.bin/eslint --fix "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 ;; esac; exit 0; }
